name: VANGUARD 5-outlet power hub
note: Harbor Freight 70071. Plugs straight into a wall outlet; also has USB ports under the covers. Rating assumed 15 A (normal for these hubs); check the label on the back.

name: Cables Unlimited 2-outlet splitter (PWR-PSLIB-2)
note: About 1 ft, 16 AWG, 3-prong. 16 gauge wire is good for 13 A (about 1560 W) across both outlets together. Amazon's "40 watts" is a listing mistake.

name: Mshyet 3-outlet outdoor cord, 1 ft 12/3
note: 12 gauge, 15 A / 1875 W, SJTW outdoor-rated, 3 grounded outlets. Heavy enough for any household load; still only one 15 A wall outlet behind it.
